column1: # tests/standins/19.tsv: what a person produces at the manual steps phase 19 reads (see tests/standin.py).
# Mostly shell rows: they run with ~/.platform-env sourced, so they use its variables and git directly.
# GE-0.2 (HUMAN): the colleague's address, saved with penv_set (GE-3.9, GE-3.11 and GE-6.13 check --witness against it;
# the test runs every apply with --witness witness@example.test).
# 17 FM-6.2 (HUMAN): the person instantiates the tenant-app repair entitlement on GEMINI_PROJECT with 17's generator,
# whose id derives from the register agent_id tenant-app (setup/19 GE-2.3), and records its full name. The generic
# fake value names another project and id, which GE-2.3 rightly refuses to take for the tenant app's.
# 17 FM-1.2: its file is the asset, written by that AUTO step; the merge on main is the person's (two reviewers). Only
# applied when --only stands 17 in; a full run writes it for real. GE-2.7, GE-3.11 and GE-8.4 then run the checker.

column3: cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && mkdir -p tools && cp "$(dirname "$(command -v python3.12)")/../../assets/fm-zero-diff.py" tools/fm-zero-diff.py && chmod 755 tools/fm-zero-diff.py && git add tools/fm-zero-diff.py && git commit -qm "test stand-in: 17 FM-1.2 zero-diff checker, merged" && (git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true)

column1: # GE-2.1 (HUMAN): the run spec filled from the register row, merged on main by two reviewers, and its merge commit.

column3: cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && mkdir -p factory/runs && jq -n --arg p "$GEMINI_PROJECT" --arg d "$DOMAIN" '{spec_version: 1, module: "tenant-app", run_id: "dev-19-tenant-gemini-prod", calling_file_step: "19 GE-2.1", register_row: "register/tenant-app.yaml", register_commit: "test-register-commit", manifest: null, agent_id: "tenant-app", env: "prod", register_tier: "C", project_variable: "GEMINI_PROJECT", project_id: $p, create: false, parent_folder_variable: "FLD_GEMINI_ENTERPRISE", labels: {agent: "tenant-app", owner: "ge-admins", tier: "ge", env: "prod", data_class: "internal", ai_act_class: "limited", recovery_class: "standard", cost_centre: "tbd", created_by: "bootstrap-hand", factory_run: "dev-19-tenant-gemini-prod"}, tags_effective: {"agp-tier": "ge", "agp-env": "prod", "agp-tisax-scope": "in"}, services: ["discoveryengine.googleapis.com", "modelarmor.googleapis.com", "logging.googleapis.com", "monitoring.googleapis.com", "cloudquotas.googleapis.com"], service_dependencies: [], log_routing: {default_bucket: "default-europe-west1", location: "europe-west1", retention_days: 30, trace_bucket: true}, budget: {display_name: ($p + "-budget"), amount: 0, reason_if_not_tier_default: "live app on the existing billing account; budget decision pending"}, essential_contacts: [{email: ("platform-security@" + $d), categories: ["SECURITY", "TECHNICAL"]}, {email: ("platform-owners@" + $d), categories: ["TECHNICAL"]}], service_accounts: [], project_bindings: [], allowed_human_members: [], notification_channels: [], trigger_sink: null, project_floor: {applies: false, reason: "the tenant app is a live service; its Model Armor posture is the template pair and app-level settings of 19 GE-7, not a floor written by an import", vertex_ai: false}, deny_entries: [], pab_bindings: [], project_org_policies: [], project_deny_policies: [], entitlements: ["ent-project-repair-tenant-app"], lien: false, made_elsewhere: [{item: "Model Armor for the tenant app (template pair ge-console-standard, FAIL_CLOSED)", file: "19", step: "GE-7"}], pending: [{check: "services.subset_of_folder_allowlist", reason: "the fld-gemini-enterprise allow-list is decided in 19 GE-3.1 and set in GE-3.5", owner: "platform owner", rerun_in: "19 GE-3.11"}, {check: "project.parent", reason: "the move is 19 GE-3.10", owner: "platform owner", rerun_in: "19 GE-3.11"}, {check: "project.labels", reason: "the labels are set with the move in 19 GE-3.10", owner: "platform owner", rerun_in: "19 GE-3.11"}, {check: "tags.effective", reason: "agp-tier=ge is inherited from fld-gemini-enterprise after the move in 19 GE-3.10", owner: "platform owner", rerun_in: "19 GE-3.11"}, {check: "iam.no_human_or_basic_role", reason: "standing human roles are removed one at a time in 19 GE-5.8 and the spec revised in GE-5.9", owner: "platform owner", rerun_in: "19 GE-5.9"}, {check: "budget.tier_default", reason: "licence-driven, *tbd* (02 section 2.2)", owner: "platform owner", rerun_in: "the budget decision of 02 section 2.2"}, {check: "budget", reason: "licence-driven, *tbd* (02 section 2.2)", owner: "platform owner", rerun_in: "the budget decision of 02 section 2.2"}]}' > factory/runs/gemini-prod.json && git add factory/runs/gemini-prod.json && git commit -qm "test stand-in: 19 GE-2.1 tenant-app manifest, merged" && (git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true) && penv_set --force GE_MANIFEST_COMMIT "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"

column1: # GE-3.1 (HUMAN): allow-list-final, the union of enabled and design services on the governed list, after the person's
# browser check and signed drops (22 services, discoveryengine among them, as GE-3.1's and GE-3.5's gates require).
# GE-3.2 (HUMAN): the folder's allow-list file rewritten from allow-list-final, merged on main by two reviewers.

column3:
cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && mkdir -p policies/folders/fld-gemini-enterprise && { printf 'name: folders/%s/policies/gcp.restrictServiceUsage
spec:
  rules:
  - values:
      allowedValues:
' "$FLD_GEMINI_ENTERPRISE"; sed 's/^/      - /' "$(ls -t "$BUILD_LOG_DIR"/ge-baseline/*-GE-3.1-allow-list-final-v*.txt | head -1)"; } > policies/folders/fld-gemini-enterprise/gcp.restrictServiceUsage.yaml && git add policies/folders/fld-gemini-enterprise/gcp.restrictServiceUsage.yaml && git commit -qm "test stand-in: 19 GE-3.2 fld-gemini-enterprise restrictServiceUsage = union, merged" && (git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true)

column1: # GE-4.2 and GE-4.3's file blocks and their one reviewed pull request (the page's "After merge") are a person's work;
# they are stood in with GE-4.1, the manual step before them, so that the two AUTO steps' set-policy runs in the test.
# One data source (google_drive) and no supplier FQDN, so the page's placeholder FQDN ge-egress-none.invalid.

column3:
cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && mkdir -p policies/folders/fld-gemini-enterprise && printf 'name: folders/%s/policies/discoveryengine.managed.allowedDataSources
spec:
  rules:
  - enforce: true
    parameters:
      allowedDataSources:
      - google_drive
      enforcedProjects:
      - projects/%s/
' "$FLD_GEMINI_ENTERPRISE" "$GEMINI_PROJECT" > policies/folders/fld-gemini-enterprise/discoveryengine.managed.allowedDataSources.yaml && printf 'name: folders/%s/policies/discoveryengine.managed.allowedEgressFqdns
spec:
  rules:
  - enforce: true
    parameters:
      allowedEgressFqdns:
      - ge-egress-none.invalid
      enforcedProjects:
      - "%s"
' "$FLD_GEMINI_ENTERPRISE" "$GEMINI_PROJECT_NUMBER" > policies/folders/fld-gemini-enterprise/discoveryengine.managed.allowedEgressFqdns.yaml && git add policies/folders/fld-gemini-enterprise/discoveryengine.managed.allowedDataSources.yaml policies/folders/fld-gemini-enterprise/discoveryengine.managed.allowedEgressFqdns.yaml && git commit -qm "test stand-in: 19 GE-4.2 and GE-4.3 connector constraint files, merged" && (git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true)

column1: # GE-6.2 (HUMAN): the decision record the DPO signed yes, merged; GE-6.3 reads the newest one.

column3: cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && mkdir -p decisions && f="decisions/$(date -u +%F)-ge-sensitive-logging-off.md" && printf '%s\n' "# Gemini Enterprise: sensitiveLoggingEnabled false" "" "- Field: Engine.observabilityConfig.sensitiveLoggingEnabled; console: Enable logging of prompt inputs and response outputs" "- Today (GE-6.1): unset; proposed: false" "- Reason: chat content about named employees; who asked what is the StreamAssist audit entry" "- Consequence: trace correlation keeps working without payloads" "" "Signed: yes, by the DPO (test stand-in), $(date -u +%F)" > "$f" && git add "$f" && git commit -qm "test stand-in: 19 GE-6.2 DPO-signed sensitive-logging record, merged" && (git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true)

column1: # GE-6.10 (HUMAN): the signed CmekConfig record and the decision letter on the checkpoint note. Decision (a), so GE-6.11
# to GE-6.13 read as not applicable: (b) and (c) register through a long-running operation that the offline fake
# cannot answer (GE-6.12 polls its name until done).

column3: cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && mkdir -p decisions && f="decisions/$(date -u +%F)-ge-cmekconfig.md" && printf '%s\n' "# Gemini Enterprise: CmekConfig for the eu location" "" "- Options: (a) do not register; (b) register without set_default; (c) register with set_default=true" "- Decision: (a), do not register for now" "" "Signed: IT security, the DPO and the second human (test stand-in), $(date -u +%F)" > "$f" && git add "$f" && git commit -qm "test stand-in: 19 GE-6.10 CmekConfig decision record, merged" && (git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true) && checkpoint GE-6.10 DONE witness@example.test - "decision (a): repo:$f"

column1: # GE-5.9 (its spec block is a person's pull request, two reviewers): allowed_human_members follows GE-5's access, plus
# platform-security@ for GE-7.1's view, and the iam pending line goes.

column3: cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && jq --arg u "group:$GRP_GE_USERS" --arg s "group:$GRP_PLATFORM_SECURITY" '.allowed_human_members = ([$u, $s] | unique) | .pending |= map(select(.check != "iam.no_human_or_basic_role"))' factory/runs/gemini-prod.json > factory/runs/gemini-prod.json.new && mv factory/runs/gemini-prod.json.new factory/runs/gemini-prod.json && git add factory/runs/gemini-prod.json && git commit -qm "test stand-in: 19 GE-5.9 tenant-app allowed_human_members, merged" && (git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true)
